**Is your extension proposal related to a limitation? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of the pipeline constraint (e.g., expanding the stopping margin delta calculation).

**Describe the proposed extension**
A clear description of what you want to add or change (e.g., adding an extra layer rotation parameter to the 12-qubit circuit, implementing a different percentile error margin).

**Policy/Control Group Impact**
How will this feature interact with the baseline control comparisons (Fixed-128, Fixed-1024, or Budget-Shuffled-AS95)?

**Additional context**
Add any mathematical definitions, cumulative chart examples, or formatting suggestions for NeurIPS-compliant visualization.
